name: Lithia Motors, Inc.
tagline: Leading U.S. automotive retailer with diversified revenue streams across new vehicles, used vehicles, finance and insurance, and aftersales services
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu total reflète la performance globale de l'entreprise à travers tous ses segments clés (véhicules neufs, occasion, financement et services), et démontre sa capacité à générer une croissance diversifiée dans un environnement de normalisation des marges.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of new vehicles.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in new vehicle revenue driven by higher average selling prices.
kpis.description: New vehicle revenue increased 2.1% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to a 2.5% increase in average selling prices, partially offset by a 0.9% decrease in unit sales.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'M $' (values are in millions, not billions)

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of used vehicles.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in used vehicle revenue driven by unit volume and pricing increases.
kpis.description: Used vehicle revenue increased 5.9% in 2025 compared to 2024, supported by a 3.3% increase in unit sales and a 2.8% increase in average selling prices.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from finance and insurance products related to vehicle sales.
kpis.signal: Stable growth in finance and insurance revenue supported by higher per-unit revenue.
kpis.description: Finance and insurance revenue increased 3.9% in 2025, driven by increased unit sales from acquisitions and higher finance reserve per unit from third-party lenders.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from vehicle repair and maintenance services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in aftersales revenue reflecting sustained demand for service operations.
kpis.description: Aftersales revenue grew 7.0% in 2025, reflecting continued strong demand for vehicle repair and maintenance services across the store base.

kpis.explanation: Total gross profit realized on sales after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.signal: Moderate increase in total gross profit offset by margin compression in vehicle sales.
kpis.description: Total gross profit increased 3.1% in 2025, driven by improvements in aftersales and finance and insurance margins, partially offset by decreases in new and used vehicle gross profit.

kpis.explanation: Gross profit on new vehicle sales.
kpis.signal: Decline in new vehicle gross profit reflecting margin normalization to pre-pandemic levels.
kpis.description: New vehicle gross profit declined 9.0% in 2025 due to an 8.2% decrease in average gross profit per unit as margins continue normalizing toward pre-pandemic levels.

kpis.explanation: Gross profit on used vehicle sales.
kpis.signal: Modest increase in used vehicle gross profit driven by unit volume growth.
kpis.description: Used vehicle gross profit increased 1.3% in 2025, supported by a 3.3% increase in unit sales, partially offset by a 0.7% decrease in average gross profit per unit.

kpis.explanation: Gross profit generated from aftersales service operations.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in aftersales gross profit indicating robust service segment performance.
kpis.description: Aftersales gross profit increased 10.4% in 2025, demonstrating strong performance in the high-margin service operations segment.

kpis.explanation: Gross profit as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in gross profit margin driven by new vehicle margin compression.
kpis.description: Total gross profit margin declined 20 basis points to 15.2% in 2025, primarily due to lower margins on new vehicle sales as the company normalizes pricing toward pre-pandemic levels.
kpis._validation: No unit change required, already in %

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue from new vehicles generated by stores operating in both comparable periods.
stories_kpis.signal: Modest organic new vehicle revenue growth on same store basis.
stories_kpis.description: Same store new vehicle revenue increased 1.3% in 2025, driven primarily by a 2.0% increase in average selling prices, partially offset by a 1.2% decrease in unit sales.

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue from used vehicles generated by stores operating in both comparable periods.
stories_kpis.signal: Strong organic used vehicle revenue growth driven by unit volume and pricing.
stories_kpis.description: Same store used vehicle revenue increased 5.8% in 2025, driven by a 3.6% increase in retail unit sales and a 2.4% increase in average selling prices, with particular strength in CPO (+10.2%) and value auto categories (+25.3%).

stories_kpis.short: Same Store Total Gross Profit Margin
stories_kpis.name_fr: Taux de Marge Brute Totale (Même Magasin)
stories_kpis.name_en: Same Store Total Gross Profit Margin
stories_kpis.explanation: Gross profit margin as a percentage of revenue calculated on a same store basis.
stories_kpis.signal: Stable margin performance on same store basis despite vehicle mix changes.
stories_kpis.description: Same store total gross profit margin declined 20 basis points to 15.3% in 2025, reflecting the normalization of vehicle margins partially offset by strong aftersales performance.
stories_kpis._validation: No unit change required, already in %

ai_positioning.summary: Lithia Motors operates in the automotive retail sector and has no direct involvement or disclosure concerning artificial intelligence in the provided 10-K excerpts.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Heightened competition in automotive retail could impact sales volumes and gross profit margins as competitors vie for market share. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intensifying competition in automotive retail poses risks to sales performance and profit margins for the company.

risks.title: Credit Risk Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Significant credit exposure from financing operations could materially impact financial results if customer defaults increase. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Exposure to credit risk through financing operations could significantly impact financial performance in case of increased customer payment defaults.
